title: SystemTime::duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap() in server_stores.rs lacks explanation comment
description: server_stores.rs new_with_ipfs (line ~120) and new_mem_impl (line ~196) call SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap() without a comment explaining why the unwrap cannot fail. lifecycle.rs has the same pattern but documents it with '// SAFETY: system clock is always after UNIX_EPOCH on any supported platform'. The unwrap in server_stores.rs is safe for the same reason, but the missing comment means a future reader (or clippy -D clippy::unwrap_used) cannot tell it was considered. Add the same explanatory comment.
